CONTACT_EMAIL_CONFIRMED.evidence: contact@novraintelligence.com supplied directly by the site owner. A role address on the owned domain; no personal mailbox is published.

HUMAN_LAUNCH_APPROVAL.evidence: Explicit written authorization from the site owner: 'I explicitly authorize making novraintelligence.com public.' Given after the five-article corpus was published and verified, and conditioned on a read-only pre-launch check that was performed and matched.

CSS_INSTALLED.evidence: no stylesheet can be installed on this site and the gate cannot close as written. novraintelligence.com is on the free plan, where Custom CSS is not available. Three routes were tried against the live site: global-styles styles.css keeps ordinary declarations but drops every custom-property declaration while keeping var() usages; global-styles settings.custom returns {}; a <style> element in a core/html block is stripped by KSES and its text left visible on the page. The design ships as inline styles instead (site/build-inline.mjs). This gate closes only if the plan gains Custom CSS and a hash read back from the site matches site/novra.css.

T0_CAPTURED.evidence: data/search/t0/T0-2026-09-01.json, sha256 289dcf74c001b8c49bad0e53d9bbf0e60fb4994af7a35daf7b74c8e4a31e4320. 7 queries, 63 results, captured while novraintelligence.com had never been publicly reachable — so it is a true pre-intervention baseline. Captured with the WebSearch tool, NOT SerpApi: the configured SerpApi key was rejected on 2026-08-31 and again on 2026-09-01. The file records that limitation in full: positions are list ordinals rather than verified organic ranks, and snippets are null because the tool returns none. Directionally usable and citable as a contemporaneous record; re-measure ranks against a real SERP API before making any rank-delta claim.

MEDIA_SYNC_COMPLETE.evidence: 8 assets uploaded and referenced by Media Library URL; every one verified by comparing media_details.filesize in the create response against the local file. That check caught a corrupt transfer (attachment 48 came back 3 bytes larger than source) which was re-uploaded as 50 and the bad copy deleted. The mobile convergence variant remains deliberately unuploaded: selecting it needs a max-width media query, which an inline style cannot express, so no page on this plan could reference it.

CORE_PAGES_DEPLOYED.evidence: all six pages published on blog_id 257059568 behind the Coming Soon gate, each echoed back with no _content_warnings: Home 21 (static front page), Insights 20, Research 19, Technology 24, About 22, Contact 17. The pillar article is post 18. Six superseded drafts holding the canonical slugs, and the default Hello World! post, were moved to trash.

FINAL_QA_PASS.evidence: QA runs against the exact markup deployed, rendered with no stylesheet at all at 1600/1024/620/390: zero horizontal overflow, no text whose colour matches its backdrop, grids reflowing 4/2/1. Link audit across all deployed payloads: 0 broken, every href resolving to one of the 6 live pages or 5 live permalinks, every img src present in wp-media.json. 0 placeholders in deployed content. 6 pages and 5 posts live, no duplicates, no WordPress defaults. Live read-back over HTTP still cannot run while the site is Coming Soon.

visualCorrectionPass.plan: free (wpcom_free_grace), platform simple, custom domain novraintelligence.com, launched/public
defectsFixed: INVISIBLE HEADLINES (live regression). The flattener emitted .accent as a gradient with background-clip:text and color:transparent. WordPress.com strips background-clip and its -webkit- prefix from inline styles but keeps the gradient and the transparent colour, so four public headlines rendered as invisible text inside a coloured bar. .accent is now a solid #4d84ff, and site/build-inline.mjs throws at build time on either background-clip or color:transparent. Home 21, Research 19, Insights 20 and Technology 24 were rebuilt and re-pushed.

TEMPLATE PLACEHOLDER CONTENT. pub/assembler//footer shipped '123 Example Street', 'San Francisco, CA 12345', 'Monday-Friday 8am - 6pm', 'hi@example.com', '(123) 456-7890' and a 'Designed with WordPress' credit. Replaced with a NOVRA footer carrying only content that is true: the wordmark, one descriptive line, contact@novraintelligence.com, and a five-link nav row. No address, phone number, business hours or legal entity was invented to replace them.
THEME CTA. The 'Learn more' button in pub/assembler//header was removed.

CONTENT WIDTH. wp:post-content used constrained layout on the page and single templates, which caps every direct child at the theme's 620px content size and squeezed the whole NOVRA payload. Both now use layout type default; each page supplies its own wrap width (1200px, 760px for articles).

DUPLICATE ARTICLE HERO. pub/assembler//single rendered wp:post-featured-image at 4/3 in addition to the 16:9 hero already inside each article body, so every article showed its hero twice with the theme copy cropped. The template block was removed; the featured image is still set on each post and still used for social cards and listing cards.
DEFAULT COMMENT UI. The comments block was removed from single, and comment_status was set to closed on all five posts (the six pages were already closed).

NAV COLOURS. The header navigation referenced the theme's greyscale presets (theme-1 text, theme-5 overlay), which resolve to near-black against the new dark shell. Replaced with explicit NOVRA hexes, including the mobile overlay.

THEME-DEFAULT LISTING AND ERROR PAGES. index, archive, home, search and 404 shipped the Assembler defaults: a fixed 3-column grid of 4/3 crops that cannot reflow at 390px, a light-theme search field, and a bare 'Page Not Found'. All five were rewritten in the NOVRA system, with the grid switched from columnCount to minimumColumnWidth 320px so it reflows.
DEFAULT CATEGORY. All five posts sat in 'Uncategorized', publicly reachable at /category/uncategorized/. Term 1 renamed to Analysis (slug analysis).

visualAssetDeployment.widthCorrection: WordPress.com strips box-sizing, so every .wrap had been rendering content-box since launch: a 1200px max-width with 1.5rem padding gave a 1200px column where the design calls for 1152, and 760 instead of 712 on articles. compensateForContentBox() in site/build-inline.mjs now subtracts the padding from the max-width. All 6 pages and all 5 posts were republished to carry it, so the whole site is consistent rather than partly corrected.
